ev.q: Sixty male patients who were active or former coal miners had radiographic findings consistent with PMF
a total of 60 patients identified through a single radiologist’s practice
Thirty-one patients (52%) were determined to have category A PMF
On June 9, 2016, a radiologist contacted NIOSH to report a sharp increase
This report describes a cluster of 60 cases of PMF

methods_quotes.q: A case of practice-identified PMF was defined as an International Labor Office classification of large opacity category A, B, or C pneumoconiosis (PMF)
All radiographic classifications were performed by the reporting radiologist
